description:
Perform heteroscedasticity diagnostic testing and robust estimation using the loaded 'food.gdt' dataset.

1. Estimate an OLS model: Dependent variable 'food_exp', Regressor 'income'.
2. Run White's test for heteroscedasticity on the model.
3. Run the Breusch-Pagan test for heteroscedasticity on the model.
4. Re-estimate the model using Heteroscedasticity-Consistent (Robust) standard errors.
5. Save ALL results (the initial OLS, both tests, and the robust estimation) to a single text file at: /home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/hetero_test_results.txt
